title: Jira Integration Foundation
goal: Open the first enterprise workflow handoff path by adding Jira-only integration configuration, finding linkage, and on-demand status synchronization without creating a shadow runtime lane.
scope: Implement the first integration slice with a generic integration configuration model that supports only Jira in this slice, an API path to link findings to Jira issues, and on-demand sync of the linked issue state back into AegisPT. Keep Slack, Teams, ServiceNow, and generic webhooks out of scope for this slice.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to Jira-only configuration, finding linkage, and on-demand sync. Defer notifications, ServiceNow, Teams, Slack, and generic webhook work.
notes: Use a generic integration configuration model so later integrations can reuse it, but support only integration_type = jira in this slice.
Expose configuration and sync through API and existing finding surfaces rather than inventing a new runtime workflow.

success_criteria: An engagement can store a Jira integration configuration through a repo-backed API contract.
A finding can be linked to a Jira issue and retain the linked key, URL, and last sync state.
Operators can trigger an on-demand Jira sync and see the latest linked issue status in AegisPT.
Findings Theater or adjacent finding detail surfaces expose the linked Jira issue truthfully.
API and browser coverage prove the Jira-only slice without implying that other integrations exist yet.

acceptance_criteria: A finding can link to one Jira issue without changing the finding schema contract.
A failed Jira sync reports a truthful sync-state error instead of silently discarding linkage.
The slice remains clearly Jira-only and does not imply Slack, Teams, ServiceNow, or webhook support.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
No additional integration type is added unless TASK_QUEUE.md and the task package are explicitly revised together.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the Jira foundation behavior and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the shipped Jira linkage scope and the integrations still missing.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.
